questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an overpass is coming with limited height. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet, 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must give the right-of-way to all pedestrians in a crosswalk. Stay alert when driving through intersections or turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction zones. These zones are dangerous for both drivers and workers. This sign tells you a construction zone is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will leave the freeway as an exit ramp. You can either change lanes to continue on the freeway or exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that parking spaces are reserved only for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: A triangular yield sign means you must slow down at the intersection ahead. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A stop sign requires you to come to a complete stop. Give the right-of-way to all vehicles and pedestrians in or entering the intersection. Proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should drive with the flow of traffic.
Limit your speed for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum legal speed you can drive on this road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is usually diamond-shaped with a yellow background and black markings. It warns you that a divided highway is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed. Do not make a U-turn where you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is usually yellow with black markings. This object marker warns you about hazardous objects or areas that you should avoid.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells you which direction traffic flows on a one-way street. You must obey the direction shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are used only to warn about no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that cyclists may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is usually diamond-shaped with a yellow background and black markings. This sign warns you that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that a stop sign is ahead and you should be ready to stop completely before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Should maintain your vehicle’s speed until you enter the reduced speed zone.
Should begin to reduce your vehicle’s speed.
Should not slow down because traffic will start to back up.
May reduce your speed, if you choose to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should begin to reduce your vehicle’s speed.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to start slowing down. The new speed limit will begin at the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means that action is prohibited. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers what they can do at an intersection. You may turn left or continue straight from the marked lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is posted in parking lots to mark reserved spaces for vehicles with a handicap sticker, tag, or license plate.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of two-way traffic ahead.
